transcription_convention: Manual visible transcriptions record reading order, exact words and visibly rendered punctuation; designed line wraps are normalized to spaces. No OCR is used.
closest_pair_score_convention: closest_pair_diversity uses the supplied 1–5 diversity anchor restricted to the identified nearest pair; 1 means repeated variants, 3 distinguishable with shared structural habits, 5 convincingly distinct concepts/type/spaces/material expression.
